headline: Photo Day, *Done Right.*
sub: Free to your organization. Families pay for what they want. Online ordering for every athlete.

steps.title: Book Your Date
steps.desc: Fill out the booking form and we confirm your date, time, and setup details.

steps.title: We Show Up Ready
steps.desc: We arrive with everything needed — backdrops, lighting, props. You just bring the athletes.

steps.title: Athletes Get Photographed
steps.desc: Individual portraits, team shots, and action poses. We move fast and keep energy high.

steps.title: Online Gallery Goes Live
steps.desc: Families receive a link to order prints, digitals, and packages directly. No paper forms.

features.title: Mobile-Friendly Ordering
features.desc: Parents order from their phone the same day photos go live.

features.title: Fast Turnaround
features.desc: Galleries live within 1-2 weeks of your photo day.

features.title: No Upfront Cost
features.desc: Your organization pays nothing. Families purchase what they want.

features.title: Secure Delivery
features.desc: Every order delivered digitally or shipped directly to the family.

features.title: Multiple Packages
features.desc: Digitals, prints, and custom packages available for every budget.

features.title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
features.desc: Any issues with an order, we make it right.

styles.title: Natural Style
styles.desc: Clean, classic portraits using the natural environment — gym floors, fields, courts. Timeless look that works for any sport.

styles.title: Composite Style
styles.desc: Athletes photographed individually then composited into a dramatic team image. High-impact visuals with professional backgrounds and lighting effects.
